positioning.thesis: Research generates possibilities. HNC proposes a common systems grammar. Aureon OS provides the local-first software organism. Evidence OS carries provenance, authority and review controls across it. Mission blades test where that architecture could create value.
positioning.boundary: The links below show Aureon's source-backed route from research to implementation. HNC remains a proposed grammar; public Aureon OS and Evidence OS architecture remains company-built work. Authored research, software source, commentary and prototypes do not establish independent validation, customer adoption or commercial outcomes.

artifact_roles.company_implementation: Aureon OS source and tests show a company-built local-first software organism. Evidence OS is the provenance, authority and review control plane within it. Inspection does not establish production readiness or independent assurance.
